steps.what: Search scholarly databases for relevant industrial ecology literature
Read candidate abstracts and select work relevant to actual research questions
Read selected papers and judge methods, claims, limitations and relevance
Write source-linked reading annotations and qualifications in the reference manager
Save the final reading annotations

tasks.design: Configure native saved searches in {OTHER} scholarly databases and reference-manager links. Preserve actual abstract selection, paper reading and annotations; no automatic literature summary replaces understanding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated searches across recurring research topics.
tasks.enabler_now: Native query saving and result filters.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing methods across physical science, economics and policy.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise what transfers to the actual industrial system.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated searching; scientific learning remains human work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: scholarly databases offer saved searches and filters that reduce repeated retrieval without replacing paper reading.

assumptions: Boundary is ongoing literature review through actual reading notes. Ecologist supplies research topics, keywords and filters in s1; database publishers supply title, authors, abstract, year, identifier and accessible paper link. Missing metadata or unavailable full text is resolved manually. No free relevance labels or generated review are assumed.

Native first; saved searches already in use produce zero new saving. Shares provisional, not measured. Actual screening20, reading55 and note writing4 unchanged; save1 retained. Notes already have native fields, so no extra note automation or approval ceremony.
unknowns: Existing saved searches and repeat query burden
research_questions: Which recurring queries can be saved without narrowing useful disciplines?

incremental.description: Maintain actual research queries and filters

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked final reading annotations

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional search20 reduced30 percent saves6 minus0.5 upkeep=5.5; half recurring searches gives2.5. Screening20, paper reading55, notes4 and save1 unchanged.

tasks.short: Redesign linear production systems into closed-loop systems.

steps.what: Compile actual material streams, process constraints and quality requirements
Develop potential waste-to-input connections and select feasible candidate concepts
Populate selected material-flow scenarios and calculate balances in process modelling software
Judge environmental trade-offs, contamination risks and operational feasibility
Record and check the proposed redesign and its technical limits
Save the final proposed redesign record

tasks.design: Configure native stream imports and reusable scenario structures in {OTHER} process-modelling software. The ecologist invents and selects the actual loop connections and evaluates feasibility; only repeated data preparation and scenario population reduce.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated stream reconciliation and similar scenario entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native import mappings and reusable model structures.
tasks.still_hard: Waste compatibility, contamination and practical economics.
tasks.human_edge: Find credible connections between processes and understand their trade-offs.
tasks.altitude: Less model preparation; redesign decisions remain human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: material-flow software can reuse scenario structures and imported stream data without selecting feasible industrial symbioses.

assumptions: Boundary is proposed redesign through its record, not plant implementation or supplier agreement. Operations owner supplies stream ID, material, period, quantity, unit, source process and measured quality; process specialists supply compatibility constraints. Ecologist reconciles missing inputs in s1 and enters chosen connections, conversion assumptions and constraints in s3. Manual modelling remains fallback; no free waste-classification or feasibility model.

Native first; repeated data entry and scenario setup only, never computer runtime. Existing configurations produce zero new saving. Shares provisional and unmeasured; creative design40, feasibility10, record4 and save1 retain full time.
unknowns: Native model reuse and stream-data quality
research_questions: How much scenario population repeats after actual design choices?

incremental.description: Maintain stream mappings and validate reusable scenario structures

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete checked final proposed redesign record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional preparation20 reduced40 percent saves8 and scenario25 reduced40 percent saves10 minus2 upkeep=16. Half eligible repeated inputs gives7; design40, feasibility10, record4 and save1 unchanged.

tasks.short: Prepare environmental technical reports and communicate results.

steps.what: Verify actual study results and choose supported conclusions for the report audience
outputs: verified report evidence and selected conclusions

steps.what: Populate report tables and figures from selected analysis outputs
inputs: verified report evidence and selected conclusions

steps.what: Write report narrative from the selected results and figures
inputs: verified report evidence and selected conclusions

loop.purpose: Explain selected scientific results for the actual audience
loop.input: verified report evidence, selected conclusions and figures
loop.output: draft technical report with evidence references and limitations
loop.check: Scientist checks interpretation, comparisons, units, omitted caveats and unsupported environmental claims against actual study evidence
loop.stop: Unsupported facts or two failed revisions require manual narrative
loop.why_not_simpler: Native report layouts first; variable findings and audiences require bounded prose

steps.what: Check the complete final report and intended external recipients
inputs: verified report evidence and selected conclusions

steps.what: Send the checked final report to the selected external audience
Explain actual findings and answer audience questions

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} analysis-to-report links for tables and figures, then bounded narrative drafting in {DOCS}. The ecologist verifies the complete report before external send and personally explains findings and answers questions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated figure transfer and report composition.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked outputs and source-grounded drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Communicating uncertainty without overstating environmental effects.
tasks.human_edge: Choose supported conclusions and respond to the audience's real concerns.
tasks.altitude: Less report preparation; public and scientific accountability unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native linked tables and bounded narrative drafting can reduce repeated report preparation while interpretation and external explanation remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes technical report and actual communication, with an illustrative written-report plus discussion mix. Study analysts supply result ID, variable, unit, method, uncertainty, dataset revision and source location; ecologist verifies and selects actual conclusions and outputs in s1. Missing outputs are manually prepared, not generated from unsupported claims.

Native first; existing links and runtime earn no saving. Provisional figure15 is human transfer/layout only. Ordinary final report QA10 retained; send1 retained. Ecologist has authority for named external distribution; otherwise actual release owner must approve this complete final version before send. Shares unmeasured.
unknowns: Actual report/discussion mix and release authority
research_questions: Do linked outputs and narrative checks preserve actual source revisions and caveats?

incremental.description: Maintain report links and check evidence-grounded drafting

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked final technical report and actual external recipients

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional figure15 plus narrative29 reduced40 percent saves26.6 minus2 upkeep=24.6. Half eligible preparation gives11.3; evidence/conclusions20, final QA10, external send1 and discussion25 unchanged.

tasks.short: Examine material and energy flows in industrial production.

steps.what: Reconcile actual production material and energy records across sources
Construct specified balance tables and flow diagrams in material-flow software
inputs: scientist selected system boundary and flow mapping

steps.what: Investigate imbalance, uncertainty, allocation and implications of actual flows
Record and check actual flow findings, boundaries and limitations
Save the final flow analysis record

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} material-flow imports, balance tables and diagram layouts using the scientist-selected boundary and mappings. The ecologist still resolves source problems, interprets imbalance and writes actual findings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated record reconciliation and standard flow-diagram preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native import mappings and saved balance views.
tasks.still_hard: System boundaries, uncertain measurements and allocation choices.
tasks.human_edge: Explain what the observed flows mean for the actual industrial system.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated flow preparation; analytical interpretation unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: material-flow software can populate balances and diagrams from mapped production data while expert judgement handles boundaries and interpretation.

assumptions: Boundary is examination through own analysis record. Production and meter owners supply period, site, process, stream, quantity, unit and provenance. Ecologist selects boundary, flow mapping and conversion assumptions during s1 and manually resolves gaps there; no free classification or invented measurements. Global or regional studies require actual equivalent datasets, not assumed factory exports.

Native first; s2 is repeated human balance/diagram preparation, not existing computational runtime. Provisional shares not measured. Existing native recipes yield zero saving. Actual interpretation40 and record14 unchanged, save1 retained.
unknowns: Actual dataset coverage and repeated diagram effort
research_questions: Can saved mappings preserve units, scope and actual unresolved imbalances?

incremental.description: Maintain flow mappings and validate balance outputs

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked final flow analysis record
